title: AReaL-RSI: Adaptive Scaling and Coordination of Recursive Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2610.18083v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling recursive self-improvement requires additional computation to produce useful research progress in reaching persistent objectives. Intuitively, more researcher agents can explore more hypotheses, but early evaluation scores might misrepresent their promise, shared findings could lose their applicability conditions, and useful procedures could remain confined to completed investigations. In this paper, we present AReaL-RSI, a framework for organizing a persistent research team of agents without updating backbone LLM weights. We formulate the scaling problem in terms of evaluated outcomes and whole-system resource expenditure. Concretely, a leader agent selects task-appropriate research orientations and guides ongoing investigations; conditional memory sharing distinguishes unresolved problems from supported findings and enables recipient adaptation. translated_title: AReaL-RSI：递归自我改进的自适应扩展与协调
translated_abstract: 扩展递归自我改进需要额外的计算，才能在实现持久目标的过程中产生有用的研究进展。直观地说，更多的研究者智能体可以探索更多假设，但早期评估分数可能会误判其前景，共享的发现可能会丢失其适用条件，而有用的流程也可能仍局限于已完成的研究之中。在本文中，我们提出了AReaL-RSI，这是一个在不更新骨干LLM权重的情况下组织持久智能体研究团队的框架。我们以评估结果和整个系统的资源消耗来形式化这一扩展问题。具体而言，一个领导者智能体负责选择适合任务的研究方向并指导进行中的研究；条件性记忆共享将未解决的问题与有依据的发现区分开来，并支持接收方的适配。在递归演化过程中，每次研究活动结束后，基于证据的审查会对研究进行修订……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出AReaL-RSI框架，在不更新骨干LLM权重的前提下，通过领导者智能体选择研究方向、条件性记忆共享和基于证据的审查，实现对递归自我改进的自适应扩展与协调。
en_tdlr: AReaL-RSI is a framework that adaptively scales and coordinates recursive self-improvement by organizing a persistent agent research team—using leader-driven orientation selection, conditional memory sharing, and evidence-based review—without updating backbone LLM weights.
